waivers.reason: Human gate (AF-9) chose to waive as partially satisfied rather than move the hierarchy dump into the send path, which is an architectural change affecting the F-5/F-6 boundary late in the spec. The divergence is documented in sendSteps' KDoc, not hidden.
Acknowledged explicitly by the user at the Stage 3 backlog gate. No perf-test harness exists in this repo and the plan scoped NFR-3 as manual-measurement-only (its own coverageGoal gap #5).

The installDist fix is consumer-side. Root cause is LibraryConventionPlugin wiring lifecycle-viewmodel + lifecycle-runtime-compose into every library module, which contradicts its own KDoc. Out of F-7's scope - a build-logic change with repo-wide blast radius. Routed to Stage 7.

The preview passes the staged count because nothing is encoded until the send runs; the send passes the真 attached count. They diverge only when a crop encode fails. Disclosed rather than hidden; fixing it means moving crop encoding ahead of the send button.
The plan claims the new version tests replace PP-TD-4's tautological assertion; they do not, and that assertion is untouched. Documentation defect with no code impact.

openChangeRequests.about: Perform and record the mandatory manual end-to-end demo: a real Claude Code session calling get_latest_annotation and receiving the payload; a second call with no new send returning an identical result (AC-81); the measured end-to-end elapsed time against NFR-3's <=2s; and the inline tool-result byte size against the 512 KB budget. Also eyeball the toast dismissing after its ~10s duration, the live Cmd+Enter dispatch matching the button's enablement, and whether the top-centre toast collides with the top-centre status overlay.

humanRemarks: Three Stage 5 change requests were raised and fixed on the integration branch: AF-1 (a reproduced server crash - a non-bare path in the slot killed the MCP process instead of being rejected), AF-5 (the status overlay outlived the state it described), and AF-4 (the generated prompt named a hierarchy.xml file that never exists on any path and could overstate the crop count).

AF-1 is the find of this stage: it was invisible to a 916-test green suite because the test double's resolve() was more permissive than the real contract. The fix corrected the double rather than adding a second one.

The orchestrator independently re-verified, against the real installDist binary rather than from executor reports: initialize/tools-list/tools-call, empty-slot text, unknown-method -32601 and unparseable -32700 with loop survival in both cases, one-line responses, and the 7-jar pinned classpath.
The spec is NOT fully done. T-13 remains blocked and CR-OPEN-1 is the single blocking item.

unsatisfiedDetail.why: Server half independently verified against the real installDist binary over stdio. The CLIENT half - a real Claude Code session receiving the payload - is unverified pending T-13's demo.
Byte-identical repeat call verified at the storage layer and against the real server binary. The agent-facing repeat call through a real Claude Code session is unverified pending T-13's demo.

Partially satisfied. The four steps render with correct states and the Stream-dropped failure variant works, but the animated in-order progression the AC's wording implies is not achievable while the hierarchy dump happens at freeze time rather than during the send.
Never measured. No perf harness exists; the <=2s budget was scoped as manual-measurement-only and acknowledged as such at the Stage 3 gate. T-13's demo is its only measurement point.
